title: Owner offer-creation rules: stock <= 15 no-create and ACMEWEAR brand mandatory
owner_answer_verbatim: if we have stock <=15 units on that size - then no need to create it, but if we do create it we need to always specify our brand name ACMEWEAR - so that later all of our created uploaded own offers are able to become exclusive under our own seller rights and no one else can compete with us on price on those product offers. That's mandatory..

scope.description: Applies to all own-created/uploaded offers on any store controlled by this operating system.

rules.semantics: size-level stock balance <= 15 → do not create a new offer for that size
every own-created/uploaded offer must specify brand ACMEWEAR

applied_decisions.note: Dark-lane RUSH_WHITE size M closed as no-create because the size-level stock balance is <= 15.

open_items.note: Dark-lane remainder requires source-backed family review before any create/no-create decision.

enforcement_pointers.note: Reference only in this lane. A follow-up Web_automation lane must consume this registry before offer creation/upload validation is considered complete.
Reference only in this lane. Own-created/uploaded offer payloads and cards must specify brand ACMEWEAR.

reactivation_policy.override_requires: Only a new explicit owner decision file in config/owner_decisions/ may override this registry. The override must name this decision_id, exact rule_id, exact store scope, affected case if applicable, and intended exception.
reactivation_policy.default_without_override: Do not create a new offer for a size-level stock balance <= 15. Do not create or upload any own offer without brand ACMEWEAR.
